A supplier looks promising, a market seems to be growing, and two sources say completely different things. What do you trust when an important decision can't wait for perfect information?

Evercraft Research is now open for early-access inquiries. Start with your question, choose the kind of report you need, and download a free research scope in your browser. We quote full investigations individually, with clear deliverables and an emphasis on traceable sources, contradictions, and unanswered questions.

You can try the scope builder without an account. The link is in our first comment.

A polished answer and a defensible business decision are not the same thing.

Teams face questions that cross supplier markets, technical constraints, public records, competitors, and operational economics. The evidence can be incomplete or contradictory, yet the decision still has a deadline. Evercraft Research is opening for custom inquiries with an intentionally simple starting point: describe the question, choose a report type, and download a free research scope.

A completed report is a separate, individually quoted engagement. We're looking for genuine research problems where source-grounded analysis would help someone decide what to do next. https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/research/

The interesting part of research isn't a polished answer. It's the evidence behind it, what contradicts it, and what's missing.
